termSetScrollbackDesc: Lines of history each terminal keeps; more uses more memory.
termSetIntegrationDesc: Marks each command as succeeded or failed with its exit code, lets you send a failed command to Kun, and titles tabs after the running command. Works with zsh, bash and fish on macOS and Linux; not over SSH. Applies to new terminals.
termSetRestoreDesc: Reopens tabs, folders and up to 500 lines of output. Processes are not restored; a new shell starts in the same folder.
termSetKunProcesses: Show Kun's background processes in the terminal
termSetKunProcessesDesc: Commands Kun starts in the background from a conversation (dev servers, watchers) appear as read-only tabs you can stop or jump back from.
termSetAlertsDesc: While the terminal is hidden, a dot on the top-bar terminal button shows when an Agent waits for you or a command finishes.
termSetConfirmClose: Confirm before closing a terminal that is still running
termSetOptionMetaDesc: Option key combinations go to the shell instead of typing special characters.
termSetAgentsDesc: Agents the new-session menu can start in a terminal. {task} in the arguments becomes the task you type; when you leave it empty, that argument is dropped. Installed third-party Agents appear automatically.
termSetOpenedInTerminal: Opened in the terminal; go back to the workbench to see it.
termSetArgsHint: Keep an option and its value in one piece, e.g. --prompt={task}. When no task is given, that piece is dropped.
termSetIncomplete: Fill in the name and command.
